result.note: A one-line regulatory item; it tests only which body ordered voice-and-text-only plans.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, which body ordered telecom operators to offer cheaper voice-and-text-only mobile plans for low-income users who do not need data?
options: Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal
questions.explain: The order came from TRAI, the telecom sector regulator. The plans are aimed at low-income users who need calls and texts but not mobile data.
questions.source: TRAI ordered operators to offer cheaper voice-and-text-only mobile plans for low-income users who do not need data.
